title: ℓ_1-closeness testing of finite distributions

problem.name: ℓ_1-closeness testing of finite distributions
problem.statement_latex: Given coherent purified sample-preparation oracles for unknown $p,q$ on $[N]$ and their inverses, distinguish $p=q$ from $\|p-q\|_1\ge\varepsilon$. Both distributions have finite support.
problem.statement_text: Given coherent purified sample-preparation oracles for unknown $p,q$ on $[N]$ and their inverses, distinguish $p=q$ from $\|p-q\|_1\ge\varepsilon$. Both distributions have finite support.
